notes.title: We now have a Discord community!
notes.content: [h1]Updog Software now has its own Discord community! [/h1][p][/p][p]Join us to meet the devs, talk about our games, give feedbacks and stay up to date about our future games.[/p][p][/p][p]The standard languages of the server are English and Brazilian Portuguese.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Discord server link:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/v7vAWKZNnX"]https://discord.gg/v7vAWKZNnX[/url][/p]
